description: PETSc-specific linear algebra utility functions for creating and managing vectors.
important_notes: PETSc objects must be manually destroyed with .destroy() to avoid memory leaks.

functions.name: create_vector
functions.description: Create a PETSc Vec from an IndexMap.

functions.name: create_vector_wrap
functions.description: Create a PETSc Vec that wraps a dolfinx Vector (shares memory).

functions.name: assign
functions.description: Assign values from y (ndarray or Vec) to x (Vec). Handles both standard and nested (VecNest) vectors.
